name: Fluticasone Nasal Spray
dosing: Adults: 2 sprays each nostril OD (100mcg/nostril). Children: 1 spray each nostril OD
contraindications: Untreated nasal infection, recent nasal surgery/trauma
interactions: CYP3A4 inhibitors (ritonavir - may increase systemic exposure)
monitoring: Nasal symptoms, growth in children (long-term use), nasal septum
sideEffects: Epistaxis, nasal irritation, headache, rarely septal perforation
clinicalPearls: Very commonly prescribed. OTC available. Takes few days for full effect. Shake before use
